text: Machine learning is a way for computers to learn from data without being programmed for every task. In supervised learning, a computer uses training data to find patterns. This data includes examples with correct answers, so the computer can learn from them. The computer then builds a model, which is like a set of rules it has learned. Later, the model can make predictions about new information it has never seen before. The quality of these predictions is measured by accuracy. The more training data we provide, the better the model usually becomes at giving correct answers.
